title: Add a lead
asks: how do I add a lead

steps.say: Open the Leads tab of the CRM.
Press New. A form for the lead opens.
Fill in the name and any detail you know, then save.

title: Add a deal
asks: how do I add a deal

steps.say: Open the Deals tab of the CRM.
Press New. A form for the deal opens.
Fill in the deal name, the company and the amount, then save.

title: Move a deal to another stage
asks: change the stage of a deal
move a deal to the next stage
how do I move a deal

steps.say: Open the Deals tab. It shows the board by default.
Each column is one stage. The cards in it are the deals at that stage.
Drag a card to the column of the new stage and let go.

title: Find a contact
asks: find a person in the CRM

steps.say: Open the Contacts tab of the CRM.
Type a name here. The list narrows as you type.
Click a name in the list to open that contact.

title: Log a note on a record
asks: add a note to a deal
write a note on a lead
how do I log a call
add a note in the CRM

steps.say: Open the Deals tab of the CRM.
Open any deal on the board.
Write your note here, then press Log.

title: See the pipeline
asks: see all my deals by stage
how is the pipeline laid out

steps.say: Open the Deals tab. It shows the board by default.
This is the pipeline. Each column is a stage, left to right.
The cards in a column are the deals at that stage.
